in_sanskrit.name: Sonakshi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है With Sound or Heard
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sonakshi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sonakshi', meaning 'with sound or heard'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu culture and is associated with the beauty and grace of nature, particularly the moon.
